character_sheet: A big theropod: a 10x18x31 torso with hips and a 25-long tail behind, a neck angled up to a 9x9x12 head and a 7x9x9 snout tip with a hinged jaw beneath, a spike on each side of the head and each flank, two small 2x10x2 forelimbs, and two legs of thigh, shin, heel spur and foot (ModelAlosaurus.java:70-153; 21 parts on a 128x128 sheet). It is hostile: 110 HP, 18 damage, 8 armour, speed 0.35 (MobStats.ALOSAURUS, Alosaurus.java:94-103), 40 XP. Every fifth tick it picks the nearest living thing in sight within 12 blocks - other allosaurs, cryolophosaurs, velocity raptors and creative players excepted (:168-206) - and hands it to its dinosaur melee goal (:77-78): a chase at 1.25, a bite within 4 blocks plus half the prey's width on dice, the synched attacking flag raised for the chase and cleared when the scan comes up empty (:177); a bite knocks the victim back 1.2 blocks and up a little (:142-159). It walks through villages (:84), wanders far (:85), watches players (:86), floats (:76) and spawns in darkness at night above y 50 in a clear column, never near another (:219-229). Read it as a heavy hunter: a striding, tail-balanced walk, the little forelimbs twitching, the jaw hanging almost shut until it hunts - then snapping.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig (AlosaurusRenderer.java:20, 30) on a 128x128 sheet (ModelAlosaurus.java:155); the hitbox is 1.9 x 3.6 (ModEntities.java:34-35); shadow 1.0 (AlosaurusRenderer.java:23).

behaviour: One gait rhythm on the legs (ModelAlosaurus.java:161-171): above a walking speed of 0.1 the cosine of the age x 1.3 x 0.22, x pi x 0.25, x the walking speed is added to every part of the right leg and subtracted from every part of the left - a 45-degree stride at full speed every 22 ticks; the thigh, shin, heel spur and foot of a leg share one pivot and swing as one rigid unit around their rests (-0.174, +0.506, -0.401, 0 rad). Below the threshold the legs snap to their rests.

The jaw branches on the synched attacking flag (:172-174): calm it sits 0.1 rad (6 degrees) open and still; attacking it chomps 0.52 rad plus the cosine of the age x 0.45 x pi x 0.18 - 32 degrees either way around a 30-degree gape every 14 ticks.
The two forelimbs twitch at all times (:175-176): the cosine of the age x 0.1, x pi x 0.05 - 9 degrees around a 30-degree forward rest every 62.8 ticks, both together.
The torso, hips, tail, neck, head, snout tip and the four spikes never move; nothing reads the look (netHeadYaw unused), so the LookAtPlayerGoal (Alosaurus.java:86) turns nothing visible.

The attacking flag is raised by the dinosaur melee goal for the chase (Alosaurus.java:77-78, the accepted mapping of the original 1-in-5 combat pass, :161-167) and cleared when the fifth-tick scan finds no prey (:177) - a held state, so the bite (doHurtTarget :143-159, with its 1.2-block knockback) is transport 1.
